tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and card background. Everything sits on paper.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Quiz cards, the calendar, sheets and the shared-items panel: anything that sits on top of paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, doodle outlines, checkbox outlines, filled buttons. On paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, quantities, counts, captions. On paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink-filled button.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between categories and list sections.

tokens.name: leader
tokens.usage: The dotted line between an item and its quantity, and the dotted rule beside each city. Decorative only.

tokens.name: matcha
tokens.usage: Progress-bar fill and other packed/done fills. Never text.

tokens.name: matcha-ink
tokens.usage: Tick marks and the heading of a fully packed category. On paper.

tokens.name: hojicha
tokens.usage: Warm accent for activity gear and the hojicha cover. Fills and marks only.

tokens.name: strawberry
tokens.usage: Brand accent: selected states, the claimed badge, highlights. Fills and marks only.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: Handwritten notes and weather blurbs, set in hand-note. On paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Background of a selected quiz option or calendar range.

tokens.name: cover-strawberry
tokens.usage: Painted trip cover, strawberry (the default).

tokens.name: cover-matcha
tokens.usage: Painted trip cover, matcha.

tokens.name: cover-hojicha
tokens.usage: Painted trip cover, hojicha.

tokens.name: fill-pink
tokens.usage: Doodle fill: documents, suitcase. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: fill-green
tokens.usage: Doodle fill: clothes, people. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: fill-blue
tokens.usage: Doodle fill: toiletries, water, rain. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: fill-robin
tokens.usage: Doodle fill: tech, sun. A pale robin's-egg blue. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: fill-tan
tokens.usage: Doodle fill: activity gear. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on paper and every cover.

styles.name: hand-display
styles.usage: Trip title on the trip page, lowercase.

styles.name: hand-heading
styles.usage: Category headings, quiz questions, section titles. Sentence case, starts with "The" for categories.

styles.name: hand-city
styles.usage: City names in the weather rows.

styles.name: hand-note
styles.sample: rain on Friday, pack the umbrella
styles.usage: Weather blurbs, "why's this here?", little asides. Usually in pen.

styles.name: type-item
styles.usage: Checklist items, form inputs, body text.

styles.name: type-meta
styles.usage: Dates, counts, quantities, captions. In ink-soft.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase labels: SHARED, CLAIMED, FROM YOUR PAST TRIPS.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a row: checkbox to its tick, doodle to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between an item's parts (box, name, leader, quantity) and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between city rows; dot pitch of the dotted leader.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; padding inside cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Trip page side padding; padding inside sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between categories and major sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Quiz options, chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the calendar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the phone-sized page frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress bar, the cover badge, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only for things that float: bottom sheets and the calendar popover. Cards use a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: line-doodle
tokens.usage: Stroke width of doodles at 48-unit size.

tokens.name: line-box
tokens.usage: Checkbox and button outlines.

tokens.name: line-tick
tokens.usage: The matcha tick mark.
